$comment: Asset generation manifest. Every prompt inherits defaults.style_suffix so the whole portfolio shares one rendering doctrine (BAJAJ_ARCADE_STYLE_GUIDE.md §1). Run: node scripts/gen-assets.mjs docs/asset-manifest.json

defaults.$resolution_note: 1k costs 2.5 credits, 2k costs 10. Output is traced SVG, so 2k buys no fidelity — keep 1k.
defaults.style_suffix: Flat vector game art, two-tone shading with a single key light from the upper left: a base colour plus one darker shadow step along the lower-right edge, and one flat lighter highlight shape at the upper left. No outlines, no gradients, no gloss, no glow, no drop shadow, no text, no lettering, no background scenery. Bold simple silhouette that stays readable at 32 pixels. Centered, isolated subject on a plain flat background.
